title: Essex Meat Layer Pudding
preamble:
Ingredients:-
Suet
Pastry made with 6 oz flour
1
tablespoon butter
1
teaspoon dried sage
salt
and pepper
2
medium onions, sliced
1/4
teaspoon dried oregano
1
tablespoon flour 8 oz minced pork
1
tablespoon chopped chives
2
egg yolks
8oz
minced chicken
1/4
teaspoon celery salt
2
tablespoons double cream

Suet
Pastry made with 6 oz flour
1
tablespoon butter
1
teaspoon dried sage
salt
and pepper
2
medium onions, sliced
1/4
teaspoon dried oregano
1
tablespoon flour 8 oz minced pork
1
tablespoon chopped chives
2
egg yolks
8oz
minced chicken
1/4
teaspoon celery salt
2
tablespoons double cream

Method:-
Make the suet pastry, wrap and store in fridge for 10 mins
Fry onions in butter
Add meat, herbs, seasoning and flour
cook for 5 mins
beat eggs and cream and fold into meat
cook for 5 mins
butter 2 and 1/2 pint pudding dish
roll out dough 1/2 inch thick and put circle in dish
spoon in meat 1/2 inch thick then add alternate layers but do not fill the basin
cover and steam for 4 hours
